about_the_game:
Star Ash Fleet is a groundbreaking real-time strategy game that transcends tradition. Set against a holographic 2D battlefield simulating interstellar warfare, players assume the role of a newly appointed Federal Fleet Commander, crafting their own war epic across the vast galaxy.

• Ever-Shifting Tactics, Masterful Strategy

"No fixed formations in war, just as water has no constant shape." Our innovative fleet command system shatters the constraints of traditional RTS games, preserving strategic depth while streamlining controls. Commanders can seamlessly orchestrate entire fleets with intuitive precision or switch perspectives to micromanage individual ships down to millimeter-level adjustments, blending grand strategy with meticulous execution.

• Symphony of Spear and Shield

"Every warship embodies an offense-defense singularity - a martial masterpiece. Its triune arsenal manifests cosmic rock-paper-scissors dynamics: particle beams shred armor plating, EM pulses cripple neural networks, quantum torpedoes obliterate structural cores. Countermeasure systems perform precision symphonies - deflection shields dance, countermeasure fields resonate, gravitic vortexes crescendo. Commanders must master this cosmic calculus, orchestrating optimal loadouts to conduct their stellar sonatas."

• A Thousand Ships, Each with a Role

From nimble frigates to sky-covering carriers, five ship classes compose the symphony of interstellar war. Destroyers serve as versatile frontline anchors, cruisers pierce starry seas with railguns, carriers unleash drone swarms as self-contained tactical systems, while supply ships sustain prolonged campaigns. Only by mastering fleet synergy can victory resonate across the galaxy.

• The Triad of Life, Energy, and Ammunition

A three-resource system redefines strategy—ammo depletion may reduce titans to scrap, energy overloads disable weapon arrays, and shield failures trigger catastrophic chain reactions. Commanders must balance the fleet’s resource cycle amid chaos, where every supply run could turn the tide of battle.

• Galactic Saga, Epic and Unforgettable

"We present a century-spanning Star Wars saga through cinematic camera choreography. Each meticulously crafted level unfolds as a space opera, immersing commanders in galaxy-altering moments through dynamic battlefield events and multi-layered storytelling. When holo-table strategic maneuvers intertwine with civilization's survival narrative, every choice etches its legacy across the stars."
